description: This file provides a wrapper around the fetch API to add abort signal handling and preconnect functionality, including utility functions for request configuration.

methods.name: withDuplex
methods.description: Adjusts RequestInit to include duplex: 'half' if necessary based on request body presence.

methods.name: wrapFetchWithAbortSignal
methods.description: Wraps a fetch implementation to add abort signal handling and preconnect support.

methods.name: resolveFetch
methods.description: Resolves and wraps the fetch implementation, defaulting to globalThis.fetch if none provided.
